Stale or contradictory facts on the instructor's first screen (also a past office hour under Coming up). Proposed: Fix the fixture: complete reads "Complete"; drop past events. Overlaps: DD-2.10;DD-2.05. Reviewer R1.

Page spec still rules out a tab bar, which BD1 and BD10 allow for the global shell (BDF:7). No instructor or TA Home is drawn for iPhone or iPad. Proposed: Reword the W05 responsive line per BD1; draw instructor and TA Home for iPhone. Overlaps: DD-1.03;DD-2.14. Reviewer R1.

Entry list and action target disagree. Proposed: Correct the W02 entry text: W13 → W01 → W02. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R1.

Acceptance needs a required checkbox and then a confirm dialog; two confirmations for an act that is not one of the two irreversible events. Proposed: Keep one: the checkbox inline with the facts, or the dialog; not both. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R1.

Three wordings for one action. Who can issue a replacement and expiry length are institutional. Proposed: Use "Request a new invitation"; show issuer and expiry as labelled samples. Overlaps: DD-1.21. Reviewer R1.
A confirm dialog on a reversible, resumable skip. Proposed: Skip without a dialog; show "Finish setup in Account" once on W05. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R1.
Three models for one preference. Proposed: Pick one model and use it on W04 and W10. Overlaps: DD-1.14. Reviewer R1.

Reviewer R1.
One composite screen stands for two people; a reader takes it as one account holding both roles. Proposed: Split into an instructor frame and a TA frame. Overlaps: DD-2.15. Reviewer R1.

What a TA sees after access ends is undrawn; whether a past course stays visible is institutional. Proposed: Draw an expired TA row "Access ended Oct 25 · ask the instructor"; mark retention "not decided". Overlaps: DD-2.09. Reviewer R1.
Module names, numbers and progress change between two consecutive steps. Proposed: One module fixture for W14 and W16. Overlaps: DD-2.06. Reviewer R1.

Staff view says 2 of 3 modules published while the student sees three titles; as drawn, it is a draft-title leak or a wrong count. Proposed: Fix the count to 3 of 3, or drop the locked title unless a published placeholder exists. Overlaps: DD-2.05. Reviewer R1.
Syllabus (W15), where late and grading rules live, has no visible route from course home. Proposed: Add the Syllabus link to the course header on every course. Overlaps: DD-2.12. Reviewer R1.
Progress text does not match rows; "6 items complete" has no denominator. Proposed: Fix counts; always "n of m". Overlaps: DD-2.06. Reviewer R1.

A student can read module completion as proof of submission, or the reverse. Proposed: Per plan default 2.08: completion separate; assessment rows show their own receipt status. Overlaps: DD-2.08. Reviewer R1.
Lock reason is not next to the locked item on the phone, against the page's responsive rule. Proposed: Put the requirement text directly under the locked item. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R1.

Staff views of W16 and W17 are undrawn: instructor Edit module/Edit lesson entry and TA read-only view cannot be checked. Proposed: Draw one instructor and one TA frame for each, with the role chip and removed actions. Overlaps: DD-2.15. Reviewer R1.

On the phone the transcript, download and completion state are missing; transcript is the accessible route to the video. Proposed: Show transcript, download and completion state in the one-column layout. Overlaps: DD-2.09. Reviewer R1.

When an alternative is missing the student has no named owner to ask; the support path is institutional. Proposed: Show "Report a missing alternative" with the owner as "not decided · sample contact". Overlaps: none. Reviewer R1.
BD4 adds Late to W18, W19, W22; none of the drawn rows show it. Proposed: Add "Late" as a neutral receipt fact beside Received; no penalty text. Overlaps: DD-3.01. Reviewer R1.

Three wordings exist for received-not-released (W18 "Not released", W22 "Not yet. Your instructor chooses when.", plan "Received · Feedback not released yet"). Proposed: One phrase everywhere: "Received · Feedback not released yet"; score cell shows a dash with that label. Overlaps: DD-1.13. Reviewer R1.
The default order (personal due soonest) is not visible and cannot be changed. Proposed: Show the sort control with its current value. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R1.

One composite staff frame gives a TA course-wide counts and a Builder breadcrumb; the TA-scoped list is only a note. Counts also disagree with W14 and W05. Two words for one state on one screen; "Not received" is outside the vocabulary. Proposed: One status per screen from the single table. Overlaps: DD-1.13;DD-3.13. Reviewer R1.

Dates lack personal/course labels and a named zone; the subtitle (scenario clock) reads like a due time; iPhone close has no time (line 764). Proposed: Label "Your due" and "Closes" with time and zone on every width; remove the clock subtitle. Overlaps: DD-3.13;DD-3.21. Reviewer R1.

Before adding work the student cannot see attempts allowed or what happens after the due time. Late penalties are institutional. Proposed: Show attempts and "Late: accepted until close and labelled Late. Penalty: not decided (sample)". Overlaps: DD-3.01;DD-3.13. Reviewer R1.

The request-more-time dialog and its pending state are undrawn; a free-text reason can collect health details. Proposed: Draw the dialog with "Do not include medical details" and a pending state that says no date has changed. Overlaps: DD-3.13;DD-5.10. Reviewer R1.

W19 staff view is undrawn, and W20–W22 name no state for a staff member who follows a student link. Without a reason, staff see an unexplained dead end. Proposed: W19 staff: no Add work; instructor sees Edit, TA sees the brief only. W20–W22 for staff: W13 "This page belongs to the learner" with a link to W48. Overlaps: DD-3.13. Reviewer R1.

The spec disables review while an item is invalid; the phone lets a student go on with a broken payload. Interrupted copy also contradicts itself (line 839). Proposed: Disable with reason "One file did not upload. Retry or remove it." Overlaps: DD-3.14. Reviewer R1.

W20's button says "Review and submit" while the spec action is "Review work" and W21 holds the only send. The label suggests W20 can submit. Proposed: W20 button "Review work"; "Submit" appears only on W21 (BD9). Overlaps: none. Reviewer R1.

Tags are static text, pages cannot be reordered or removed, and the dropzone leads although the picker is the universal route. Upload limits are sample bounds. Proposed: Draw tag editor, Move up/down, Remove with dialog; picker button first; limits labelled "sample limits". Overlaps: DD-3.15. Reviewer R1.
The pre-submit status does not say the work is unsent. Proposed: "Draft saved 10:05 AM · not submitted" on W20 and W21. Overlaps: DD-1.11. Reviewer R1.

The confirmation is not tied to the payload, and target, attempt number and deadline are not beside Submit (line 889). Proposed: Per plan default 3.04: payload confirmation; whether an integrity statement is wanted is institutional, "not decided". Overlaps: DD-3.04. Reviewer R1.

A student sending after the due time is not told the attempt will be labelled Late. Proposed: Before send: "This will be received as Late (after your due time)". No penalty wording. Overlaps: DD-3.01. Reviewer R1.

The failure ladder for the one irreversible action is undrawn. The spec is sound; nothing drawn proves it. Highest-priority undrawn states in this journey. Proposed: Draw Sending, Outcome unknown with Check status, and the concurrent-send message first. Overlaps: DD-3.05. Reviewer R1.

Receipt time has no seconds, and no Copy control for the reference is drawn (only Download receipt), though the spec asks for "an explicit Copy label". Proposed: Show 10:12:07 AM EDT and a Copy receipt ID button. Overlaps: DD-3.18. Reviewer R1.
No history rail, attempt selector or new-attempt control with a disabled reason. Proposed: Draw the rail; "New attempt unavailable: closed Sun Oct 18" as text. Overlaps: DD-3.12. Reviewer R1.

The receipt does not show which page went to which question; the ID scheme for attempt 2 is undefined (line 934). Proposed: "p.1 → 1a, 1b"; define IDs per assessment and attempt. Overlaps: DD-3.18. Reviewer R1.

Unclear what is shared with help; archive card lists "Grades" though retention is institutional. Proposed: Say "Only the term name is sent"; label archive areas as a sample. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R1.
Work trail and badges mix words ("Submitted · received", "Accepted", "Locked · cannot be changed" vs "Locked" on iPad). Proposed: Trail row "Received"; one lock label. Overlaps: DD-3.18. Reviewer R1.

The submission screens use a different "now" from the rest; "marks" vs "points" also differs (line 786). Proposed: Label the Oct 15 frames as a scenario override; use "points". Overlaps: DD-3.21;DD-3.22. Reviewer R1.

resolution: One PS4 review fixture: Aisha reviewed and held, Ben received and not reviewed (1 of 2), used by W48, W51, W53 and W58 for every role; W53 lists Ben as not ready.

Proposed: One fixture truth: Maya completed Aisha and Ben; W53 scope lists 2 ready, or lists Ben under "Exceptions held" with the reason. Overlaps: DD-6.03. Reviewer R2.

Three vocabularies for one state: spec enum, drawn "Reviewed · held" / "Reviewed", and the UX-R01 word "Graded · staff only". Proposed: One staff label everywhere (queue, grader, gradebook, release): "Graded · staff only", with "In progress" and "Held revision" as the only other review states. Overlaps: DD-6.14. Reviewer R2.

Default order is deadline then received time. UX-R10 asks for random order with the order shown. Nothing shows the order in use. Queue and grader always show learner names. No "name hidden" state and no statement of when names appear. Proposed: Adopt the C5 proposal: optional per-assessment "Hide learner names while grading", aliases in the queue and grader, a line "Names return at release". Overlaps: none. Reviewer R2.

Instructor cannot see TA progress before release, and "Open next work" is ambiguous when work is split across TAs. Proposed: Add owner, grading due and progress columns plus the spec's summary strip; make "Open next work" open the next item not owned by a TA, or say whose it is. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R2.

Spec has four actions (Save question, Mark review complete, Propose rubric change, Prepare release). No undo, no "Applied: X", no shortcut map, no shortcut on/off setting. Proposed: Add session undo for score and rubric application with a visible "Applied: X · Undo"; a shortcut list where every key has a visible control and a setting to turn single-key shortcuts off. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R2.

Completed state of the button is undrawn and no rule says whether a TA can reopen a completed review before release. Proposed: Draw the completed state ("Graded · staff only" plus "Reopen review" while unreleased and in scope); completion needs no confirm dialog. Overlaps: DD-6.05. Reviewer R2.

TA grader shows access end but not scope (course, questions, number of learners) at the top. Proposed: Fixed scope strip on W48 and W49: course, questions 1a–4, 2 learners, marking due, access ends. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R2.

"Refresh impact" is open to a scoped TA but the page shows course-wide held and released counts. Out-of-scope counts could show. Wording-only change lists one held grade with no table saying why, and nothing warns that applying moves the held row to rubric v3 and makes any built W53 preview stale. Spec and drawn TA note disagree. Drawn TA table also shows a "Sample" placeholder for Ben's mark. Proposed: Follow plan default 6.01 (read-only calculation); remove the note and the placeholder. Overlaps: DD-6.01;DD-6.14. Reviewer R2.

Carmen's Missing outcome needs its own release but the drawn release page does not list her as held, excluded or a status candidate. Proposed: Scope step lists every learner: ready, held, missing (status outcome), excused, with counts. Overlaps: DD-6.02. Reviewer R2.

TA status view is drawn and good ("Waiting for the instructor"), but the deep-link denial to a release payload is undrawn, as is the BD6 phone status view. Proposed: Draw TA denied state and the phone read-only status. Overlaps: DD-6.02;DD-6.18. Reviewer R2.

Released header lacks time and version, and the drawn page has no way to start the spec's review request. Proposed: Header "Released · Oct 20, 4:05 PM EDT · release 1"; add "Request review". Overlaps: DD-3.19. Reviewer R2.

A letter appears with no published source; boundaries are institutional. Proposed: Show the letter only when W52 has a boundary table, labelled "sample boundaries, not decided"; add the official-record caveat. Overlaps: DD-3.10. Reviewer R2.

Entry list and action disagree. Proposed: Add W48 to the W53 entry list. Overlaps: DD-6.10. Reviewer R2.
Drawn page states no-undo; the spec dialog text does not, and neither uses the C4 wording. Proposed: Put the C4 sentence in the dialog spec and the drawn page. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R2.

No "feedback before score" option at release; the learner-preview bar on W23 is undrawn. Proposed: Draw the preview bar. Leave "comments first" as a later option, not a first-HTML promise. Overlaps: DD-3.19. Reviewer R2.

Correctly not a TA page. A TA cannot see how their comment reads to the student; this is the decided position. Proposed: No change. Show the TA "Students see this comment after release" beside the comment box. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R2.

resolution: A receipt keeps the Late fact computed against the due time in force when it was accepted; the W40 date-change impact panel says how many receipts keep their status.

The impact panel says "2 receipts keep their status". Overlaps: DD-5.13. Reviewer R3.

resolution: Student W14 and W16 list only published modules; a draft module title never reaches a student, per the W14 spec.

resolution: Change the W35 Preview as learner action and its acceptance check to instructor only.

notes: Same BD2 contradiction on course home. Proposed: Instructor only. Overlaps: DD-5.06;DD-2.11. Reviewer R3.

W35 is the specified entry to W36 but the drawn builder has no settings control; the route only exists through the sidebar. Proposed: Add the header Settings link on W35, or change the W36 entry text to the sidebar. Overlaps: DD-5.01;DD-5.02. Reviewer R3.

Publishing is blocked without a syllabus and valid policy, but the blocked state names only title and resources and gives no link to W36 or W52. Proposed: Add "No published syllabus" and "Grading policy not valid" blockers that link to W36 and W52. Overlaps: DD-5.04. Reviewer R3.

Two vocabularies for the AI ceiling; the learner preview must show "exactly the published AI ceiling". Proposed: Use the three enum labels as the value and keep the sentence as the explanation field. Overlaps: DD-5.14. Reviewer R3.

The access window is drawn as an editable instructor field with no owner. W35 treats code, term and section as read-only when institution-managed; W36 does not. Quiz 3 is drawn as Required for module completion, against the proposed default 2.08. Proposed: Redraw the rule as "View required lessons"; assessments are listed but never gate completion. Overlaps: DD-2.08. Reviewer R3.

Reordering modules, items and criteria has no drawn non-drag control, although the spec requires one. Proposed: Draw Move up and Move down buttons on every reorderable row. Overlaps: DD-5.18 (iPad only). Reviewer R3.

The module editor can add only lessons; assignments and quizzes cannot be started from where they will live. Proposed: Replace with an Add item menu (lesson, file, assignment, quiz). Overlaps: DD-5.01. Reviewer R3.

Three save models in one path: reorder saves a version at once, W38 autosaves, and every page also has Save draft. No undo for a single edit; Discard is all-or-nothing. The accessibility checker blocks publishing but the fix surface is incomplete; an instructor cannot mark an image decorative. Whether an exception may be documented is institutional (DD:1557). lab-sheet.pdf is Failed with no reason and no retry, so the instructor cannot recover. Proposed: Show the reason beside the file and a Retry control. Overlaps: none (W39 design-next 3). Reviewer R3.

Replace is the action that protects received work, and it is not drawn. Proposed: Draw the detail drawer and the Replace dialog with live versus frozen usage. Overlaps: none (W39 design-next 1-2). Reviewer R3.
W39 and W40 are both reachable only through controls that are not on W35. Proposed: Add the Course tools group and per-module Add item menu. Overlaps: DD-5.01;DD-5.02. Reviewer R3.

The Attach rubric step has no drawn control, and the points total that the rubric must match is not shown. Proposed: Draw the full form with question maxima and the rubric check. Overlaps: DD-5.13. Reviewer R3.

Three wordings for the same staff state, and none is the synthesis term "Graded · staff only". Proposed: Pick one staff label and use it in W05, W48, W49 and W58. Suggest "Review complete · staff only". Overlaps: DD-6.14. Reviewer R4.

The two role views of the same receipt disagree, so the instructor cannot trust the queue as a release-readiness view. Proposed: Fix the fixture to one truth. If TA completion needs instructor acceptance, show "Reviewed by Maya Chen · awaiting your check". Overlaps: DD-6.03. Reviewer R4.
The instructor queue has no owner, grading-due or access-end column and no summary strip. Proposed: Add Owner and Grading due columns and the spec's summary counts. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.

The spec's default sort is deadline then received time. UX-R10 asks for a random default order that is shown. Nothing on the page states the order. Proposed: Keep task grouping by grading due, randomise learners inside a task, and print "Order: random" with a control to change it. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.

BD6 promises a read-only phone queue and an iPad queue. Neither is drawn. Proposed: Draw the planned iPhone read-only queue (status and deadline, no open-to-grade) and the iPad queue. Overlaps: DD-6.18. Reviewer R4.

The TA cannot tell whether the review is already complete or still needs the button. Proposed: When complete, replace the button with "Review complete · staff only" and an "Edit review" control. Overlaps: DD-6.05. Reviewer R4.

The grader does not show the TA's scope (course, questions, learner count) at the top, and has no picker to move between allocated learners. Proposed: Add a scope line and the roster/question picker limited to the allocation. Overlaps: DD-6.05. Reviewer R4.

The W49 spec defines no keyboard shortcuts, no undo and no "Applied: X" line. A search of the spec line for "shortcut" and "undo" found nothing. Proposed: Add: number keys apply rubric levels, previous/next keys, a visible "Applied: X · Undo", a switch to turn single-key shortcuts off, and a visible button for every shortcut. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.

When access ends during grading the only way out is an instructor action. W45 names W49 as its entry for this, but W49 has no control and the TA has no "ask for more time" path. Proposed: Draw the scope-expired state: what was saved, what was not, who can restore access, and a link to the help guidance W05 already names. Overlaps: DD-6.05;DD-6.10. Reviewer R4.

Learner name and a name-bearing file name are always visible in the grader. There is no "names hidden" state. Open conflict C5. Proposed: See C5 observations. If adopted, the file label must also be aliased. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.
Finished work is listed under "Needs you". Proposed: Move it to a "Done" group or show a quiet state with the access-end date. Overlaps: DD-2.10. Reviewer R4.
The student calendar has no staff-task toggle and no marking deadline. Correct as drawn. Proposed: Keep. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.
The TA grader has no release control and says who can release. Correct. Proposed: Keep; reuse this line on W48 and W05. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.
A student who follows a staff URL gets the W13 access-denied template with no metadata. Not drawn for this journey, but the rule is sound. Proposed: Keep. Overlaps: DD-1.08. Reviewer R4.

resolution: Remove 8 of 10 from the W08 Quiz 2 activity item; it reads Feedback released: Quiz 2 and links to the feedback.
notes: A score is shown in an activity preview, against the page's own permission rule. Proposed: Item reads "Feedback released: Quiz 2" and links to the feedback page. Overlaps: DD-1.01. Reviewer R4.

The drawn editor mixes draft and scheduled signals, and the email line reads as already sent. The "Nothing has been sent" line is right but is contradicted beside it. Proposed: One status chip (Draft, Scheduled, Published). Email line in future tense: "Email goes to learners who chose it". Overlaps: DD-4.05. Reviewer R4.

The publish dialog with audience count is specified but not drawn, so the deliberate send step cannot be reviewed. Proposed: Draw the dialog: audience, count, time with zone, and "Published and delivered are recorded separately". Overlaps: DD-4.05. Reviewer R4.

The spec has no action after publication except editing. The plan default (withdraw with history) is not yet in the spec or drawn. Proposed: Add "Withdraw announcement" with a reason, a learner-visible "Withdrawn" row and retained history. Overlaps: DD-4.06. Reviewer R4.

The spec gives the TA a route, a preview action and a drafting acceptance check, then disables TA authoring. What the TA sees on W55 is not defined or drawn. Proposed: For the first HTML: TA gets no editor. Show "Announcements are written by your instructor" with a link to W28. Drop the drafting acceptance check until a grant exists. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.

The staff and student worlds disagree about the same announcement, so the journey cannot be walked end to end on one record. Proposed: Use two records: the published one in W28/W29 and a separate labelled draft in W55. Overlaps: DD-4.03;DD-4.02. Reviewer R4.

Staff list views are undrawn. The instructor has no Drafts/Scheduled entry. For the TA, "Create/manage" must be absent or carry a reason. Proposed: Draw the instructor list with a staff-only Drafts and Scheduled tab, and the TA list as read-only with no authoring link. Overlaps: DD-4.12. Reviewer R4.
A student cannot tell whether an updated announcement has been read since the update. Proposed: Keep the read marker and add "Updated since you read it". Overlaps: DD-4.12. Reviewer R4.

The fixture announcement tells students that held work has been graded. This bears on open conflict C6 and works against the plan's "no change at grading" proposal. Proposed: Rename the sample to a neutral notice such as "Problem Set 4 feedback: timing". Add a W55 hint when a draft says work is graded while its release is held. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.
The phone list drops search and the unread filter with no stated rule. Proposed: Add a filter disclosure that keeps the selected value visible. Overlaps: DD-4.12;DD-4.15. Reviewer R4.

W55 Preview opens the learner-facing detail page with nothing marking it as a preview, so an instructor can take a draft for a live announcement. Proposed: Add a persistent bar: "Preview. Not published. Learners cannot see this." with Back to editor. Overlaps: DD-4.13. Reviewer R4.
The required Back link is not drawn. Proposed: Add Back near the heading and at the end, per the spec. Overlaps: DD-4.13. Reviewer R4.
W28 has a phone frame but the page it opens has none. Proposed: Draw the single-column phone detail with attachment and Mark unread. Overlaps: DD-4.15. Reviewer R4.

The drawn settings have no per-type frequency, no digest and no quiet hours. Announcement and discussion alerts cannot be set to digest, and instructors have no quiet hours. Proposed: Draw the settings drawer with per-type rows (Off, Each time, Daily digest) and a staff quiet-hours row. Mark defaults as a sample, not a policy. Overlaps: DD-1.15. Reviewer R4.
Three pages state three delivery defaults. Proposed: Apply the plan default: receipts always emailed, other email off, shown the same on W04, W08 and W10. Overlaps: DD-1.15. Reviewer R4.
Phone users cannot reach delivery settings from Activity. Proposed: Add a visible settings control in the phone header. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.

Staff activity (release tasks; allocation and deadline events) is not drawn, so the TA rule "allocated grading facts only" cannot be checked. Proposed: Draw one instructor list and one TA list. Overlaps: DD-1.17. Reviewer R4.

W08 has no route to W30 or W31, so a discussion reply or a moderation outcome cannot deep-link to its thread. This journey step has no defined link. Proposed: Add W31 (and W56 for moderators) to W08's destinations, or state that discussions create no activity events. Overlaps: DD-1.07. Reviewer R4.
List and thread disagree on author and on reply count. Proposed: Fix the fixture. Overlaps: DD-4.11. Reviewer R4.
W31 has a phone frame but the list that leads to it has none. Proposed: Draw the phone list with audience and Open/Closed labels first. Overlaps: DD-4.15. Reviewer R4.

"Start a topic" is drawn as available, but whether learners may start topics is an open course policy and the audience dialog is undrawn. Proposed: Draw the dialog with audience and identity. Show the button only when the course's posting rule allows it; label the rule as a sample. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.

The manage link from the list cannot match a per-discussion route. A TA without a moderation grant needs the link absent. Proposed: Give the list link a manage-list route and the thread link a per-thread route. Hide it from TAs with no grant. Overlaps: DD-4.10. Reviewer R4.

A student who reports a post gets no dialog and no confirmation. Proposed: Draw the Report dialog (reason required, "a report does not remove the post") and a "Report received" line. Overlaps: DD-4.09. Reviewer R4.

Report status is visible to staff only. The reporter never learns the outcome. Proposed: Show the reporter their own report's status on the thread ("Your report: reviewed"), with no detail about the author. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.

The TA thread view is undrawn. A TA with a grading allocation but no moderation grant should see Report only. Proposed: Draw the TA view for both cases, with a scope line when moderation is granted. Overlaps: DD-4.09. Reviewer R4.
The drawn actions do not map to the four report statuses, and there is no "Under review". Proposed: Buttons "Hide post" and "No action", with the status chip shown. Overlaps: DD-4.09. Reviewer R4.

Hide is drawn as one click with no reason, no history and no context link to the thread. Proposed: Draw the Hide dialog (reason required, learner-readable), the action history, and a link to the post in its thread. Hide stays reversible with Restore. Overlaps: DD-4.09. Reviewer R4.

In the three-learner fixture a report count can point to the reporter. Proposed: Show "Reported" without a count below a threshold. The threshold is a labelled sample, not a policy. Overlaps: DD-4.17. Reviewer R4.

The TA view of W56 (no grant, granted, expired) is undrawn. Maya's grading allocation must not open this page. Proposed: Draw "Moderation is not part of your access · set by Dr. Reyes" and the scoped view with an end time. Overlaps: DD-4.09. Reviewer R4.
A confirmation dialog is specified for a reversible personal marker and has no control that opens it. Proposed: Make it a plain button with Undo; drop the dialog. Overlaps: DD-4.12. Reviewer R4.
The control's current state is invisible. Proposed: Show "Read" or "Unread" next to the control. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.
Activity rows are out of order. Proposed: Sort newest first and label the order. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.

A confirmation dialog is specified for every reply, though the audience is already printed above the composer and own posts can be edited. Proposed: Keep the audience line. Use the dialog only when the audience differs from the previous post (for example a group thread). Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.
Role label differs by device. Proposed: Use "Teaching assistant" everywhere. Overlaps: DD-4.14. Reviewer R4.

W56 is not in BD6's narrow list, so the protective action on a phone (hide a reported post) is undefined. Proposed: "Open on a larger screen" plus Hide post and Lock thread as the protective actions. Overlaps: DD-4.15. Reviewer R4.
Reading is not acknowledgement and no private reply exists. Drawn note matches. Proposed: Keep. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.

resolution: Registrar classes get Post a class notice; Cancel is offered only on Whiteboard-owned W32 events.

resolution: Replace Told 3 of 3 with a factual line: notice posted to Activity for 3 students, email only to students who chose it (sample); no delivery claim.

Proposed: Say "Notice posted to Activity for 3 students at 4:02 PM. Email goes only to students who chose it (sample)." Overlaps: DD-2.04;DD-1.15. Reviewer R3.

resolution: JW-235: same finding in J09 (W29→W08).
notes: A score appears in an Activity preview, against the page's own permission rule. Proposed: Remove "8 of 10"; the item reads "Feedback released: Quiz 2". Overlaps: DD-1.01. Reviewer R3.
The cancel dialog lacks scope and the reminder effect that the spec requires. Proposed: Add scope and "Reminders for this class are cancelled". Overlaps: DD-2.04. Reviewer R3.

Restore is the undo for cancel, but its effect on reminders and notices is undefined. Proposed: Restore dialog: who is told, and that reminders are not revived automatically. Overlaps: DD-2.04. Reviewer R3.
The two views disagree on whether the midterm is published. Proposed: Show drafts only to staff, labelled Draft, in the timeline. Overlaps: DD-2.13. Reviewer R3.

Posting a class notice away from a desk is a protective action, but W32 is not in the BD6 list or the Part 5 device table, and no narrow instructor view is drawn. Proposed: Add "Post class notice" as the narrow instructor action on W32; event editing stays desktop. Overlaps: DD-2.14. Reviewer R3.

The zone set in W36 drives every date in W32. The date-effects review is undrawn, and it is not stated whether existing deadlines keep their instant or their wall-clock time. Proposed: Draw the drawer; rule: instants never move silently, each affected date is listed old to new. Overlaps: none (W36 design-next 4). Reviewer R3.

Three zones exist (course, account, institution) and no page says which one W32 and W07 display. Proposed: One rule: show the viewer's account zone, named, with the course zone as a secondary label when it differs. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R3.

Source labels contradict W07 ("Copied from the registrar"), and "Unopened" is unclear. Proposed: Source reads "Registrar" or "Course"; replace "Unopened" with "Not open yet". Overlaps: DD-2.16. Reviewer R3.
The cancel notice is claimed but the student's Activity count does not change. Proposed: Increment the badge and draw the notice. Overlaps: DD-2.04. Reviewer R3.

The cancelled class is not drawn in W07, so a student with a 30-minute reminder cannot tell whether it still fires. Proposed: W07 row "Class · Cancelled · reminder removed". Overlaps: DD-2.04. Reviewer R3.
The planner disagrees with the course pages about what is due. Proposed: Remove the item or add it to the MATH 220 fixtures. Overlaps: DD-2.07. Reviewer R3.
Due items lack time, zone and course. Proposed: Each due item shows course, item, time and zone. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R3.
The drawn phone view contradicts the narrow default. Proposed: Agenda by default on the phone. Overlaps: DD-2.14. Reviewer R3.
Adding a private event, the core student planning action, is not drawn, and neither specified dialog has an opener. Proposed: Draw the editor and both dialogs. Overlaps: DD-2.09. Reviewer R3.

The two calendars disagree on whether a TA can open the deadline view. On W07 the TA has a disabled control with no owner named. Proposed: Instructor sets deadlines (proposed default). The TA sees "Set by Dr. Reyes" and a link to their own tasks on both pages. Overlaps: DD-2.11;DD-6.16. Reviewer R3.
One composite screen stands for two roles and does not demonstrate the privacy rule. Proposed: Split by role; add one private event to the staff fixture. Overlaps: DD-2.15. Reviewer R3.
The TA planner after access ends is undrawn. Proposed: Draw the expiring and expired states. Overlaps: DD-2.09. Reviewer R3.

The dialog already tells the TA while the question is listed as open; the TA view of W32 is undrawn. Proposed: Decide yes (the TA holds a course role and attends), and draw the TA read-only view. Overlaps: none (W32 design-next). Reviewer R3.
The Reminder settings step lands on a list with no settings entry on the phone. Proposed: Add the settings button to the phone header. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R3.
Class reminder lead, the control this journey ends on, is not drawn. Proposed: Draw the settings drawer with reminder lead. Overlaps: none (W08 design-next). Reviewer R3.

Delivery defaults conflict in three places. If all optional delivery is off, a reminder exists only while the app is open, and the student is not told. Proposed: Adopt default 1.15; add a line "With email and browser alerts off, reminders appear only in Whiteboard." Overlaps: DD-1.15. Reviewer R3.
Chronology is broken. Proposed: Newest first. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R3.

Instructors are meant to get digests and quiet hours; W08 has no field for either and no instructor list. Proposed: Add a digest and quiet-hours choice for staff, labelled sample; draw the instructor list. Overlaps: DD-1.17. Reviewer R3.
The TA Activity list is undrawn, so the scope rule is unproven. Proposed: Draw it with allocation and deadline items only. Overlaps: DD-1.17. Reviewer R3.
TA syllabus preview (see J04). The published syllabus is harmless, but the wording should not be "preview". Proposed: TA opens the published W15 in staff view. Overlaps: DD-5.06;DD-5.08. Reviewer R3.
No direct route from W36 to W32; reached by course nav. Proposed: Keep. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R3.
Repetition. Proposed: Show the reason once. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R3.
"At time" and "at start" for the same choice. Proposed: Use "At start" in both. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R3.
Student is denied W36 and reads the result on W15 and W32. No problem. Proposed: none Overlaps: none. Reviewer R3.

resolution: Relabel the W46 basis reference Instructor only; a TA never sees it.

resolution: Add Ask about timing for this quiz on W25: a typed request to W46 that changes nothing until the instructor decides; requests after close stay a labelled open policy.

Proposed: Add "Ask about timing for this quiz" on W25: a typed request to W46 that changes nothing until decided. Whether requests are allowed after close stays a labelled open policy. resolution: Compute the W25 late-start line from the student's own duration (Start by 11:29 PM Thursday for the full 30 minutes) and show remaining time in the Start dialog.
notes: The late-start warning gives a student with accommodated time the wrong cut-off, against BD3. Proposed: Compute it from the student's own duration: "Start by 11:29 PM Thursday to get your full 30 minutes", and show the real remaining time in the Start dialog. Overlaps: DD-3.02. Reviewer R4.

resolution: Re-base the W54 regrade example on released Quiz 2; a request needs a released snapshot.
notes: The drawn regrade request is against unreleased work, which implies the learner saw a held score (question 2, 5 of 6). Proposed: Re-base the example on Quiz 2, per the plan default. Add a rule: a request needs a released snapshot. Overlaps: DD-6.04. Reviewer R4.

The route is per learner and the drawn page has no request list, so the instructor has no place to find or decide a request and cannot end an allowance. Proposed: Add a course-level index with pending requests, a decision view (approve with adjustment, decline with reason) and an End allowance dialog. Overlaps: DD-5.11. Reviewer R4.
The TA's timing-only view is undrawn. Proposed: Draw a TA chip in the queue and grader: "Adjusted time: 30 minutes", no reason, no link to W46. Overlaps: DD-5.08. Reviewer R4.

W46 names the grader as an entry point, but the grader has no such control. Proposed: Enter from the W48 missing-work row ("Review allowance") and correct the entry text. Overlaps: DD-6.10. Reviewer R4.

The request dialog and the pending, approved and declined outcomes are undrawn. The spec's state list has no approved or declined state. Proposed: Draw the dialog and three outcomes on the status card: "Request sent · not an extension yet", "Approved · your new due date is …", "Declined · reason". Overlaps: DD-3.13. Reviewer R4.

After an allowance the student cannot tell that the date shown is their own. Proposed: Show "Your due date" first with "Course due date" as a secondary line, both with a zone. Overlaps: DD-3.13. Reviewer R4.
The phone drops the close time, which is the fact an exception request depends on. Proposed: Show the time and zone on the phone status card. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.
Two status words for one state, and neither is in the BD9 vocabulary. Proposed: One word per state from the single status table. Overlaps: DD-1.13;DD-3.01. Reviewer R4.

The reason field can collect health details that the instructor then sees. Proposed: Add helper text above the field: "Say what you need, not why. Do not include health or personal details." The support route for accommodations is institutional and not decided. Overlaps: DD-5.10. Reviewer R4.

W46 can excuse an assessment, but W19 has no "Excused" state, so the student-side result of an excuse is undefined. Late (BD4) also has no drawn W19 state. Proposed: Add Excused and Late to W19's states with neutral wording. Overlaps: DD-3.01;DD-3.13. Reviewer R4.

The staff read-only view of the assignment is undrawn, so nothing shows that the TA cannot approve a request here. Proposed: Draw the read-only view. Instructor gets Edit. TA gets the brief only. Overlaps: DD-3.13. Reviewer R4.
Start looks available before the quiz opens. Proposed: Not-open state: exact opening time, no Start, no checkboxes. Overlaps: DD-3.17. Reviewer R4.

A student whose allowance fails to load is blocked from starting, with no owner named and no statement about the closing window. Proposed: Draw the state: "Your timing could not be confirmed. Starting is paused so you do not lose time. Dr. Reyes sets quiz timing." plus Refresh and Help. Overlaps: DD-3.17. Reviewer R4.

The on-screen wording announces that an accommodation exists. 04#9 asks for neutral words such as "Your time". Proposed: Show "Your time: 30 minutes". Use the same line in the W46 learner preview. Overlaps: DD-6.19. Reviewer R4.

The spec gives a "staff preview" state on W25 to any authorised staff, while BD2 removes TA preview. W25 is not in BD2's page list, so a TA preview still exists here. Proposed: Instructor keeps the preview bar. The TA view is titled "Quiz rules (read-only)" and shows published rules only, with no learner-specific timing. Overlaps: DD-5.06. Reviewer R4.

This step has no link. BD5's "My attendance" section and typed correction request are decided but not yet in the W14 or W58 specs, so the request W58 reviews has no source. Proposed: Write BD5 into W14 and W58: the request record, its statuses and where the student sees the outcome. Overlaps: DD-6.11. Reviewer R4.
The W58 attendance enum still uses "Late", against BD4. Proposed: Rename to "Arrived late". Overlaps: DD-3.01. Reviewer R4.

The TA view is undrawn. Maya's grading allocation should give no access here. Proposed: Draw "Attendance is not part of your access · set by Dr. Reyes" and a scoped variant for a granted TA. Overlaps: DD-6.17. Reviewer R4.

The fact tiles disagree with the queue and mix denominators, so the missing-work and exception facts cannot be trusted. Proposed: Fix the fixture. Give each tile its denominator in words and a source time. Show excused work as excluded, per the spec. Overlaps: DD-6.03. Reviewer R4.

Attendance is one link per learner. There is no bulk set, no Record dialog and no Correct dialog. Proposed: Add a one-screen session entry with bulk set and a per-row override. "Not recorded" stays the starting state. Overlaps: DD-6.17. Reviewer R4.

W58 does not link to W54, and the queue entry W54 relies on is not drawn. This step does not resolve. Proposed: Add a "Review requests" filter or tab to W48 with a count. From W58, link attendance requests only; keep grade requests in W54. Overlaps: DD-6.10. Reviewer R4.

The instructor screen shows the TA's verb and lacks the instructor's own decisions. Proposed: Instructor header: Request clarification, Decline with reason, Save correction held. The TA view has Propose correction only. Overlaps: DD-6.13. Reviewer R4.

The TA proposal view is undrawn, so the "candidate, not a decision" rule is not visible. Proposed: Draw it with "Your proposal goes to Dr. Reyes. Only the instructor can decide or release." Overlaps: DD-6.13. Reviewer R4.

In the "Correction held" state the request tells the learner a correction exists before it is released. This is the C6 question at the regrade stage. Proposed: Learner sees "Under review" until release, then "Feedback updated" with old and new values. "Correction held" stays a staff word. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.

Nothing tells the student what happens next or that a score can go up or down. Response times are institutional. Proposed: Add "A review can raise or lower the score" before sending. Show any response time as a labelled sample, not decided. Overlaps: none. Reviewer R4.
An extra attestation is drawn that the spec does not have. Proposed: One acknowledgement, per the spec. Overlaps: DD-3.17. Reviewer R4.
A future session is marked Present, and the breadcrumb is wrong. Proposed: Use a past session or a labelled scenario override; fix the breadcrumb. Overlaps: DD-6.17;DD-6.14. Reviewer R4.

The instructor needs last term's course as the source, but no staff past-term view or source picker is drawn. Proposed: Draw staff past term and the W59 source picker. Overlaps: DD-5.19;DD-2.09. Reviewer R3.
One composite staff screen shows two people's sessions. Proposed: Split by role. Overlaps: DD-2.15. Reviewer R3.
The drawn checkbox contradicts the spec and the proposed default. Proposed: Remove Announcements. Overlaps: DD-5.05. Reviewer R3.
The instructor may assume TA access or group sets carry over. Proposed: List every omission from the dialog text in the preview. Overlaps: DD-5.05. Reviewer R3.
The checkbox does not say the grading policy arrives as a draft that must be reviewed in W52. Proposed: Label it "Grading policy (as a draft to review)". Overlaps: none. Reviewer R3.

The instructor appears to create a Spring 2027 offering. Who creates an offering is institutional. Proposed: Label the result "Draft copy. Not an offering until the school links it (sample; not decided)". Overlaps: none. Reviewer R3.
